# ThreadSanitizer Suppressions for Expanse
#
# Expanse uses Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) with seqlock version
# validation and Epoch-Based Reclamation (EBR).
# Readers perform optimistic (plain) loads of trie nodes and leaf arrays
# concurrently with single-writer mutations.
#
# Below, we suppress ONLY the underlying node/leaf/blob/bucket storage
# manipulations where optimistic reader loads race with in-place writes.
# Concurrency coordination primitives (such as writer mutexes, reader counters,
# Collector/Epoch advance in occ.rs/occ32.rs, and Sync* wrapper protocols)
# are NOT suppressed so genuine concurrency bugs are detected by TSan.

# Node and slot read/write paths
race:expanse_trie::map::*
race:expanse_trie::mutate_map::*
race:expanse_trie::mutate::*
race:expanse_trie::set::*
race:expanse_trie::bits::*
race:expanse_trie::slot::*
race:expanse_trie::trie32::*
race:expanse_trie::bytesmap::*
race:expanse_trie::strmap::*
race:expanse_trie::blobmap::*

# Source file paths for storage engines
race:map.rs
race:mutate_map.rs
race:mutate.rs
race:set.rs
race:bits.rs
race:bytesmap.rs
race:strmap.rs
race:blobmap.rs
race:trie32.rs
